Inkling-2 details: "ViT is back" 

Yeah i would never have called this hMLP thing encoder-free, and i don't think it was a good idea to use that as an encoder in the first place. Makes no sense to spend multiple enc layers on patches without lookaround.
Glad they saw the light.
posts.quoted: Interesting Notes on Inkling 2 Small release: Note: every single word is written by me. I used AI to fact check several things I doubted about, but that's it. (1) Architecture (A) 48-layer decoder-only transformer. 594B total. (B) 17B active. Sparse MoE feed-forward backbone.
